query:
Independently research disclosed outside funding events for ONLY the ventures below. Read /workspace/deal_rules.md and /workspace/funders_audit_sample.csv. User needs a funding audit, not licensing or company metadata. Search web freshly (no facts from memory); about 3-6 searches/fetches each, more for many rounds. Include ALL disclosed events: seed, angel, accelerator, series, grants, crowdfunding, token, debt, secondary etc. One row per event with columns exactly key,venture,type,label,date,amount_usd,lead,investors,source_url,confidence. Types from rules, or none_found only after reasonable searches. Date YYYY-MM; blank when month unknown, explain in notes. Amount digits USD, blank undisclosed; avoid unsubstantiated exchange conversion. People 'Full Name (person)', firms usual names, lead excluded from investors, separators ' | '. Each event source must actually name investors or amount. Prefer company/investor/filings/reputable news; fetch sources, don't infer investors across rounds. Acquisition/IPO not ordinary funding; include IPO only if outside capital issued and clear amount. Keep distinct secondary deals; don't duplicate total cumulative amounts as separate rounds. If no funding, none_found row and note search scope; distinguish bootstrapped if sourced. Need one line per venture on searches and uncertainties. Explicitly report which ventures NOT fully researched (reasonable search with none found counts researched; unresolved material event histories count incomplete). Save CSV to /workspace/audit_work/group1.csv and notes JSON to /workspace/audit_work/group1_notes.json, JSON list of objects with key, note, incomplete(boolean), sources(list URLs checked). Save full BibTeX for EVERY used web source using e14c.web.save_citation (load citation-integrity skill). Persist search/fetch evidence in /workspace/audit_work/group1_evidence.json or .md. Do NOT overwrite root .deliverables.json or other groups files. Final answer short with local file paths and incomplete count. You have ~35 min; prioritize full coverage and trustworthy sources. Ventures:
key,venture,universe,category,website,github_orgs
BruceDevices,Bruce Devices,U1,COSS (GitHub core),bruce.computer,BruceDevices
Cheshire-Labs,Cheshire Labs,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://www.linkedin.com/company/cheshire-labs/,Cheshire-Labs
coqui-ai,Coqui,U1,COSS (GitHub core),,coqui-ai
dbeaver,DBeaver Corp,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://dbeaver.com,dbeaver
e2b-dev,E2B,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://e2b.dev/,e2b-dev


If this task asks for a specific answer format, follow it. Write any prose in plain, complete sentences that a scientist outside this project could follow, and explain any labels, task IDs, or abbreviations you use.

Current date: 2026-11-26
answer:
## Files Ready for Analysis

| File | Description | Format | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/workspace/audit_work/group1.csv` | Funding audit: 14 rows, including explicitly flagged candidate events | CSV | 2.8 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group1_notes.json` | Per-venture search scope, uncertainties and incomplete flags | JSON | 9.7 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group1_evidence.json` | Search results, fetched pages, source URLs, retrieval parameters and validation | JSON | 2.8 MB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group1_sources.bib` | Full citations for 38 fetched sources | BibTeX | 13.7 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group1_reproduce.py` | Validation and optional fresh-retrieval script | Python | 2.5 KB |

The CSV is the analysis file; the remaining files are supporting material. Sources and transformations for each event are documented in the notes and evidence. Amounts were not currency-converted, inferred from cumulative totals, or taken from valuations. Crowdfunding monthly receipts were not treated as campaign totals.

**Incomplete count: 3 — Coqui, DBeaver Corp and E2B.** Their unresolved database-only rounds, potential duplicates and conflicting totals are explicitly flagged. Low-confidence candidate rows must not be counted as separately confirmed financings.

The requested rules and sample files were absent, so funding-type labels are provisional. The requested citation-integrity skill was unavailable; citations were nevertheless saved using `e14c.web.save_citation`, also at `/workspace/citations/default_project/84dea63a-6319-43c0-a0ff-0a9d45ebc0ba.bib`.

Recheck with: `python /workspace/audit_work/group1_reproduce.py`.
